# agent-trash-guard

> Recoverable-delete safety net for coding agents: blocks permanent-delete shell commands and redirects them to a trash you can inspect and restore.

Use this repo when you need to:
- stop a coding agent's `rm`, `unlink`, `shred`, `rmdir`, `find -delete`/`find -exec rm`, or `git clean -f` from running unattended
- give an agent a recoverable alternative (`agent-trash put`, `list`, `restore`, `empty`) instead of an unrecoverable delete
- reclaim the storage those recoverable deletes accumulate (`agent-trash gc`), under a size budget, collecting only what git proves nothing still points at
- install a native pre-tool hook in Claude Code, Codex CLI, or Gemini CLI from one portable Agent Plugin root
- teach an agent the trash workflow via the bundled `agent-trash-guard` skill

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/hermes-labs-ai/agent-trash-guard/blob/main/README.md) — install per host, what gets blocked, the escape hatch, and how the hook works
- [skills/agent-trash-guard/SKILL.md](https://github.com/hermes-labs-ai/agent-trash-guard/blob/main/skills/agent-trash-guard/SKILL.md) — canonical skill an agent reads to use the CLI and know the guard's limits
- [tests/recoverability-demo.sh](https://github.com/hermes-labs-ai/agent-trash-guard/blob/main/tests/recoverability-demo.sh) — self-contained proof the guard blocks a delete and the trash round-trip loses nothing

## Install

- Claude Code: `claude plugin marketplace add hermes-labs-ai/agent-trash-guard && claude plugin install agent-trash-guard@hermes-labs` — the plugin is also listed in the org-wide marketplace `hermes-labs-ai/claude-plugins` as `claude-trash-guard`, for discovery alongside other Hermes Labs Claude Code plugins.
- Codex CLI: `codex plugin marketplace add hermes-labs-ai/agent-trash-guard && codex plugin add agent-trash-guard@hermes-labs`
- Gemini CLI: `gemini extensions install https://github.com/hermes-labs-ai/agent-trash-guard --ref main`
- Skill only (any host that reads skills.sh): `npx skills add https://github.com/hermes-labs-ai/agent-trash-guard --skill agent-trash-guard`

## Do not use this repo as

- a sandbox or filesystem permission system — it pattern-matches specific delete commands, it does not confine what an agent can touch
- protection against overwrites or truncations — out of scope for v0.1
- a backup or archival system — `agent-trash gc` reclaims space under a budget, it does not preserve anything off-machine
- coverage for every possible delete spelling — it is a hook over known Bash/`run_shell_command` patterns, not a kernel-level guarantee
- a supported integration for every agent runtime — OpenClaw and local Hermes Agent/client tooling are noted as adapter candidates in the README, not live integrations

## Key facts

- No dependencies beyond Python 3 (stdlib only) and bash
- Guard behavior, the `agent-trash` CLI, retention (`gc`), and the skill are exercised by `./tests/run.sh` and `tests/recoverability-demo.sh`
- `gc` decides with one ordered ladder, first match wins: 1 protected denylist, 2 git state unknown, 3 reachable, 4 newer than the age floor, 5 over budget (collect oldest first), 6 keep; a failing git call is UNKNOWN and is never read as clean
- Current release: v0.1.3, MIT licensed
